question: Can the audited parameterized inherited carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) be landed into the shipped kernel through the sanctioned promotion path - so that after promotion the shipped execution path contains a concrete parameterized mechanism that an inherited procedure visibly instantiates and executes on new identifiers, together with a companion known-negative refusal certificate - such that blocker B1 (per research/portfolio/PROGRAM_AUDIT_2026-10-10.md) is satisfied and the pre-freeze executable mechanism required by readiness condition (1) exists, rather than once more running the four-arm COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL/SPIDER economics benchmark on a kernel that still emits only literals at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 execution threshold?
hypothesis: Installing the audited carrier byte-identically into src/spider/kernel.py (leaving src/spider/models.py, src/spider/registry.py and src/spider/__init__.py untouched) makes the shipped execution path induce four parameterized mechanisms (one per family x resource-type pair, confidence 0.9, support-constrained slots) and EXECUTABLE-resolve every held-out novelty-0.0 update_resource task with a new identifier on the frozen credential-free real-HTTP substrate (10/10, postconditions verified over the live socket, zero cold fallback), while refusing 30/30 known-negative probe tasks with a null bound_action and a correct refusal category (out-of-support identifier, missing parameter, wrong intent). The byte-delimited counterfactual is demonstrated because the pre-install literal-only kernel (git blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50) cannot induce the parameterized path (raise AttributeError), produces only 0.5-confidence literals (below the 0.8 default threshold), and - being support-blind - over-accepts the very out-of-support identifier (doc-999) that the installed kernel refuses. The whole delta (src/spider/kernel.py + one new regression test) passes compileall, the full unittest discovery suite and validate_repo.py, and is confined to the Product lane's allowed code roots, so the sanctioned promotion path can land it.
falsifier: The claim is falsified (status=FALSIFIES, no promotion) if any of the following holds with measurement-valid inputs: (F1) fewer than 4 parameterized mechanisms are induced from the frozen training observations, or any induced mechanism's canonical serialization differs from the vendored-reference induction, or fewer than 10/10 held-out novelty-0.0 tasks resolve EXECUTABLE and complete with postconditions verified over the real socket (or any task needed a cold/literal fallback); (F2) the 30-case known-negative battery is not refused 30/30 with bound_action=null and the expected EXPLORE/UNKNOWN status and refusal reason for every category; (F3) the pre-install kernel does not over-accept the out-of-support identifier (i.e., no discriminating pair exists, or the pre-install bytes already contain a parameterized/refusal path); or (F4) the promotion suite (delta scope within {src/spider/kernel.py, tests/test_ship_kernel.py}, python -m compileall -q src scripts, PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v including the new regression test, python scripts/validate_repo.py) does not pass on the delta. A frozen-input identity failure (installed kernel sha256 != 718efa6a..., or any frozen artifact hash mismatch, or code-root drift between request.base_sha and the recorded pre_execute_sha) or an infrastructure failure makes the measurement invalid (status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID) instead of a scientific negative.
baselines: B-PREINSTALL-LITERAL: the shipped kernel at the allocation base (src/spider/kernel.py, git blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) contains only literal distill() (confidence 0.5) and no distill_parameterized(); it is the status-quo comparator that promotion replaces.

B-PREINSTALL-OVERACCEPT: the same pre-install bytes, loaded in isolation together with the sha256-identical src/spider/models.py + src/spider/registry.py + src/spider/__init__.py, resolve the out-of-support identifier doc-999 as EXECUTABLE (support-blind over-accept) once the induced mechanism is upserted into its registry - the byte-delimited counterfactual that attributes the refusal path to the carrier delta.

B-LITERAL-FLOOR-REF (inherited evidence, not re-run): EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 established B-LITERAL-KERNEL success 0.0 (200/200 EXPLORE at the frozen confidence gate) vs PC-EXACT-REPLAY 20/20 on this identical carrier, confirming the scoring apparatus discriminates literal-incumbent from parameterized-path.

B-NOT-RUN (explicitly out of scope per director mandate): the four-arm COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL/SPIDER-model economics benchmark is NOT executed this cycle; paying for it before B1 is removed is explicitly not funded (request.json director_mandate.allocation.rationale).
positive_control: PC-PARAM-BINDING: a hand-authored parameterized Mechanism (slots document/property/value/session_token, support grammars identical to the induced ones, confidence 0.9) upserted into an EMPTIED registry of the installed kernel must resolve update_resource for identifier doc-026 with EXECUTABLE and the correct bound action URL - proving the scoring apparatus can witness a known-positive slot binding independently of the inducer. Inherited instrument-sensitivity anchor (not re-run): PC-EXACT-REPLAY 20/20 in EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 on this identical carrier.
null_control: NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: the installed kernel with an EMPTIED registry must resolve a positive-shaped held-out task as UNKNOWN with bound_action=null (no candidate), proving the certificate outcome is not an artifact of an always-EXECUTABLE resolver. NC-REFUSAL-NULL: every one of the 30 known-negative battery trials must additionally have bound_action=null (refusal is 'no action', never a partial action).
measurement_validity: M1 REAL-HTTP-ONLY: every positive and control execution and every induced-mechanism verification happens over real localhost stdlib HTTP(S) request/response cycles on the frozen SubstrateServer (SEED=42, credential-free, 127.0.0.1 only); no synthetic in-memory verification shortcut is permitted for outcome-bearing evidence.

M2 DETERMINISM: single deterministic run, single SubstrateServer instance for the entire certificate; the mechanism's action_template embeds the server base_url (port), so all induction and all execution share one bound base_url; task order is by build_test_tasks() iteration order.

M3 IDENTITY PINS (byte-level): installed src/spider/kernel.py sha256 must equal 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 and git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796; src/spider/models.py 338aaf4d7ba0e31f7a5fe8a47abdbb2ea52d9c1c4ef0ce014f2b809b9a2a9b78, src/spider/registry.py 51fb440d3827f21cccb5f77ad17dc0e76ccdbc2d52d7b05044cd821bb8a9322c and src/spider/__init__.py 3d173722b38c5130a5145b1558412a399f851c8ed4fbf2ddfa4022e4cb2b5a77 must remain unchanged; all 9 freeze_artifacts hash-verified before and after the run.

M4 NO-FALLBACK: a held-out positive counts only if the executed action was produced by the induced parameterized mechanism (mechanism_id prefix 'mech-', confidence 0.9); any cold/literal/repair re-derivation of the action disqualifies the task from the numerator.

M5 REFUSAL IS RESOLVE-LEVEL: the 30-case known-negative battery is executed at resolve() level with no HTTP action transmitted whenever bound_action is null; the refusal certificate is about emitting no action, and this is verified by a null bound_action on all 30 trials.

M6 COUNTER HONESTY: model_calls=0 and model_tokens=0 by construction (no model invoked); retrieval_calls=1 per resolve() call is instrumentation from the carrier's own counter hook and is NOT interpreted as economics; latency_ms plays no role in any decision (deterministic counters only, per inherited audit required_fixes[1]); all accounting counters recorded raw per task.

M7 DELTA-SCOPE: the promotion delta (request.base_sha -> EXECUTE head) restricted to Product allowed_code_roots (src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml) must be exactly {src/spider/kernel.py, tests/test_ship_kernel.py}; anything else in the code roots makes the run MEASUREMENT_INVALID (promotion would carry unintended code).

M8 INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY: the scoring apparatus is bracketed by PC-PARAM-BINDING (must be EXECUTABLE) and NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY (must be UNKNOWN); the absorption/discrimination floor is the B-LITERAL-FLOOR-REF inherited 0.0-vs-1.0 contrast on this identical carrier.

M9 MEASUREMENT_INVALID vs FALSIFIES precedence: frozen-input identity failure (M3/M7 or freeze-hash mismatch), server malfunction (known-good PC fails with non-200), or governance/checkpoint drift => status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact blocker recorded; any of F1-F4 with valid measurements => status=COMPLETE with outcome=FALSIFIES (a first-class scientific negative); all gates pass => status=COMPLETE with outcome=POSITIVE.

M10 NO-BENCHMARK CLAUSE: the run must not execute COLD, INSTRUCTIONS, RETRIEVAL or SPIDER-model arms; the derived/ artifacts must contain an explicit assertion that no such arm ran (mandate compliance).

decision_rule.overall: outcome=POSITIVE iff G0 and G1 and G2 and G3 and G4 all PASS (status=COMPLETE). Any of G1-G4 FAIL with valid measurements => outcome=FALSIFIES (status=COMPLETE): blocker B1 not cleared, no promotion, claim retained EXPERIMENTAL. G0 FAIL (identity/drift) or infrastructure failure => status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INVALID, no promotion, exact blocker recorded.

product_consequence_positive: If the verdict adopts POSITIVE: the audited delta (src/spider/kernel.py = carrier bytes b15ed848, tests/test_ship_kernel.py) is left promotion-ready on the Product lane; verdict promote_to_product=true, audit PASS is expected; the sanctioned product-promote.yml workflow applies the delta to main, compiles, runs the full test suite and validate_repo.py, and ships it; blocker B1 is cleared: the shipped execution path now contains a parameterized EXECUTABLE carrier with a demonstrable known-negative refusal certificate, which unblocks readiness condition (1) for the later economics benchmark. Suggested claim update for C-PARAM-INHERIT: status VALIDATED (bounded to 'shipped executable parameterized carrier + refusal path present on deterministic credential-free substrate; economics and model-agent benefit are explicitly not claimed here'), with the bounded statement in the event reason. Next eligible product work becomes the B2 non-ceiling task-bank certificate using the shipped carrier.
product_consequence_negative: If any gating core F1-F4 fails (outcome=FALSIFIES) or the measurement is invalid: NO promotion, NO code delta on main, claim C-PARAM-INHERIT retained at EXPERIMENTAL (no advance), promote_to_product=false in verdict; preserve raw evidence and record the exact failing gate with its measurement rather than re-asking the same question; the smallest next step is derived from the failed gate (e.g., F1: repair the driver/induction recipe; F2: repair the refusal classification; F3: repair the isolation or the discrimination claim; F4: repair the delta scope or the new regression test). A governance defect (freeze gate not enforced, checkpoint drift, artifact mutation) is recorded as a blocker and routed to the Global Research Director; the four-arm benchmark remains unfunded until B1 is genuinely cleared.
estimated_cost: Deterministic local run: ~62 real HTTP cycles over 127.0.0.1 (20 training captures + 20 held-out executions + refusal battery at resolve level + positive control + identity/suite checks), single-threaded stdlib HTTP server/client, wall time on the order of minutes; model_calls=0, model_tokens=0, no browser, no external network, no paid API; promotion suite adds compileall/unittest/validate_repo local execution only.
expected_information_gain: The experiment resolves blocker B1, the program-level first dependency of the product lane and a prerequisite for all later economics work: it decides, with byte-attributable counterfactual evidence, whether the audited parameterized carrier can be shipped through the sanctioned path together with a known-negative refusal certificate. The discriminating contrast (analogous pre-install bytes over-accepting the identifier the installed carrier refuses, on sha256-identical shared modules) converts the install claim from an assertion into a measurement, and every outcome (POSITIVE / FALSIFIES / MEASUREMENT_INVALID) changes the product decision and next action. It deliberately avoids spending the unfunded four-arm benchmark on a kernel that still cannot execute.
